title: Open chat and send a question with sources
description: This verifies that the chat page accepts a question, shows a streamed assistant reply, and presents cited source chips linking back to textos.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Enter a question about the saved textos
Send the question
Verify an assistant reply is displayed
Verify source chips are displayed for the reply

title: Land on textos from the root redirect
description: This verifies that opening the app takes the user to the textos workspace automatically.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the user lands on the textos workspace

title: Open the app and land on the textos workspace
description: This verifies that opening the app takes the user to the textos workspace where the list and workspace summary are visible.

steps.description: Navigate to /
Verify the textos workspace is displayed
Verify the workspace summary and textos list are displayed

title: Edit, preview, and save a texto
description: This verifies that a user can update a texto, preview the rendered markdown, and save the changes successfully.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click a texto in the list
Update the title field
Update the markdown body field
Switch to the preview view
Save the texto
Verify rendered markdown is displayed in the preview
Verify the saved texto remains available

title: Create a new chat conversation and send a question
description: This verifies that a user can create a new conversa in chat, send a question, and see the conversation populate with a user message and assistant reply.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Create a new conversa
Fill in the message field with a question about the saved textos
Send the message
Verify the user message appears in the conversation
Verify an assistant reply is displayed

title: Create a first texto
description: This verifies that a user can create a texto with a required title and markdown body and see it added to the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Fill in the title field with Texto de teste
Fill in the markdown content field with a short paragraph and a list
Submit the create form
Verify the new texto appears in the list
Verify the workspace summary is displayed

title: Create a first texto and see it in the list
description: This verifies that a user can create a texto with the required title and markdown content and then see it appear in the textos list.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Fill in the title field with Introdução
Fill in the content field with a valid markdown note
Submit the create texto form
Verify the new texto appears in the list
Verify a generated workspace summary is visible

title: Open an existing texto and edit its content
description: This verifies that a user can open a texto, change its title and markdown body, save the changes, and see the updated content in the editor.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click a texto in the list to open it
Fill in the title field with an updated title
Fill in the content field with updated markdown content
Save the texto
Verify the saved confirmation is visible
Verify the updated texto content is displayed

title: View the textos list and workspace summary
description: This verifies that the textos page shows existing items together with the workspace summary.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Verify textos are listed and the workspace summary is displayed

title: See cited source textos in a chat reply
description: This verifies that a chat response includes source chips that link back to the relevant textos when the assistant cites sources.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Create a new conversa
Fill in the message field with a question that should use saved textos
Send the message
Verify source chips are displayed in the assistant reply
Verify the cited sources link back to textos

title: Open an existing texto for editing
description: This verifies that selecting a texto opens its editor with the texto content available for review and changes.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click a texto in the list
Verify the texto editor is displayed
Verify the texto content is available for editing

title: Continue an existing chat conversation with a follow-up question
description: This verifies that a user can open an existing conversa, review prior messages, and append a follow-up question to the same thread.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Select an existing conversa
Verify prior messages are displayed
Fill in the message field with a follow-up question
Send the message
Verify the new assistant reply is appended to the same conversation

title: Review prior chat messages and continue the same conversation
description: This verifies that an existing conversation keeps earlier messages visible and appends a new assistant reply after a follow-up question.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Open an existing conversation or create a new one
Review the prior chat messages
Send a follow-up question
Verify the conversation still shows earlier messages
Verify the new assistant reply is appended

title: Preview rendered markdown in a texto
description: This verifies that a user can switch a texto into preview mode and see the markdown rendered before returning to editing.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click a texto in the list to open it
Switch to preview mode
Verify the rendered markdown preview is displayed
Switch back to editing mode
Verify the editing textarea is displayed

title: Delete a texto from the list and confirm removal
description: This verifies that a texto can be removed from the list after browser confirmation and no longer appears afterward.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click the delete control for a texto in the list
Confirm the deletion prompt
Verify the texto no longer appears in the list

title: Delete a texto from the editor and return to the list
description: This verifies that a user can delete the currently open texto from the editor and confirm it no longer appears in the textos list.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click a texto in the list to open it
Delete the texto from the editor
Return to the textos list
Verify the deleted texto no longer appears in the list
Verify the textos list is displayed

title: Create a new conversation from the chat sidebar
description: This verifies that the chat sidebar lets the user start a fresh conversation and see the sidebar state update after selection.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Create a new conversation
Select the new conversation in the sidebar
Verify the conversation sidebar shows the selected conversation
Verify the chat area shows an empty or fresh conversation state

title: Show the empty state when no textos exist
description: This verifies that the textos page presents an empty state before any texto is created.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Verify an empty state message is visible when there are no textos

title: Delete a texto from the editor
description: This verifies that a texto can be deleted directly from the editor and is removed from the workspace.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click a texto in the list
Delete the texto from the editor
Verify the texto is removed from the workspace
Verify the user returns to the textos list

title: See the empty chat state before sending the first message
description: This verifies that opening a conversa with no messages shows the empty state and still allows the first question to be sent.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Create a new conversa
Verify the empty state message is visible
Fill in the message field with a first question
Send the message
Verify the conversation now contains messages

title: Switch between Textos and Chat in the header
description: This verifies that the header navigation lets the user move between the main app areas and back again.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Click the header navigation to open Chat
Click the header navigation to return to Textos
Verify the user can move between the main workspace sections

title: Return to textos with the brand link
description: This verifies that the brand link brings the user back to the textos list from another section of the app.

steps.description: Navigate to /chat
Click the brand link in the shell
Verify the user returns to the textos workspace

title: Keep a texto from being created without a title
description: This verifies that the create form blocks submission when the required title is missing and shows validation feedback.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Fill in the markdown content field with content without a title
Submit the create form
Verify a title validation error is visible
Verify the texto is not created

title: See the texto not found state for an invalid texto id
description: This verifies that opening an invalid texto id shows the not found state and lets the user return to the list.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Open a texto using an invalid id route
Verify the texto not found message is visible
Return to the textos list
Verify the textos list is displayed

title: Read the footer identity and contact details
description: This verifies that the app shell shows the expected institutional footer information in Portuguese.

steps.description: Navigate to /textos
Verify the footer identity and contact information are visible
